success_patterns: When snippets seem inconsistent, compare how well each supports the full clue and check whether differences in entity or timeframe explain the conflict.

patch.reasoning: The skill already advises matching the full clue and combining evidence, but does not explicitly explain how to handle conflicting snippets. In two trajectories, the answer depended on weighing evidence across multiple details and recognizing a temporal distinction rather than following an isolated statistic or claim.

edits.content: When relevant snippets appear to conflict, assess which evidence best supports the full combination of clue details. Check whether apparent contradictions reflect different entities or timeframes before rejecting an otherwise well-supported candidate.
